name: The Commons at Calabasas
summary: The Commons at Calabasas is an upscale open-air lifestyle center featuring distinctive Mediterranean architecture, lavish landscaping, and dynamic fountains. This Caruso-developed property offers a curated collection of premium shopping and dining experiences, including sophisticated fashion retailers and celebrated restaurants in an elegant European village setting.
demographics: The Commons at Calabasas attracts an affluent, upscale demographic reflective of the wealthy Calabasas area and surrounding communities in the western San Fernando Valley. Primary visitors include high-income families and professionals with household incomes exceeding $150,000, along with a notable celebrity presence given Calabasas' reputation as a celebrity enclave. The trade area draws from nearby affluent neighborhoods including Hidden Hills, Agoura Hills, and Westlake Village, with shoppers seeking premium dining experiences and upscale retail in an open-air Mediterranean setting. Visitors tend to be style-conscious consumers aged 30-55 who value quality over discount pricing and prefer experiential shopping combined with chef-driven dining options.
description: The Commons at Calabasas stands as a premier open-air lifestyle destination in the heart of one of Southern California's most affluent communities. Developed by Caruso, the renowned creator of iconic properties like The Grove and Americana at Brand, this Mediterranean-inspired center features distinctive architecture, lavish landscaping, and dynamic fountains that create an elegant European village atmosphere. The property offers a carefully curated mix of upscale shopping and dining experiences, including sophisticated fashion retailers like Zimmermann and elysewalker with personal styling services, alongside celebrated culinary destinations such as KazuNori (the hand roll bar from legendary sushi chef Kazunori Nozawa), Marmalade Cafe, and Bacio di Latte's Affogato Bar. The center's commitment to experiential retail is evident through its Caruso Signature membership program, which provides enhanced events, early access, and exclusive rewards to frequent visitors. With its prime location at 4799 Commons Way and operating hours designed for convenience (Monday-Thursday 10am-7pm, Friday-Saturday 10am-8pm, Sunday 11am-7pm), The Commons at Calabasas has established itself as the ultimate shopping, dining, and entertainment destination for discerning consumers in the western San Fernando Valley.
